newsitem.title: USA: Tripos, Arena to collaborate on research.
newsitem.headline: Tripos, Arena to collaborate on research.

text.p: Tripos Inc and Arena Pharmaceuticals said Tuesday they formed a scientific and business collaboration to develop new drugs.
The agreement includes an equity investment by Tripos in California-based Arena. Details were not disclosed.

Arena will provide proprietary receptor identification technology, screening and biology. Tripos will provide proprietary informatics technology and access to its compound library of over 100,000 diverse chemical compounds.
Tripos supplies software, research services and compound libraries to the pharmaceutical, biotechnology and other life science industries worldwide.
Arena is a privately held biotechnology company developing therapeutics discovered using proprietary screening technology.
